name: São Paulo FC 2006-08 (Muricy Ramalho)
scopeNote: São Paulo FC under Muricy Ramalho (managerId muricy-ramalho), three consecutive Brasileirão titles (2006, 2007, 2008) and the 2006 Libertadores final. Start is the day he took charge (3 Jan 2006, English Wikipedia); the date of his first competitive match was not found, so 2006-01-03 is used. End is the last Brasileirão match, 7 Dec 2008 (Goiás 0-1 São Paulo in Gama, DOL). His time continued until 19 June 2009 (sacked after a fourth consecutive Libertadores elimination by a Brazilian side); 2009 is excluded at the user's request and 2009 facts are kept verified false. SHAPE: the premise of a 'flat 4-4-2' is NOT documented for these years. What sources show: the 2006 title-game XI (Gazeta SP, retrospective) is a back four with four midfielders and two forwards on paper, but the only match-level 2007 line-up found (Lancepédia, Grêmio 0-2 São Paulo, 5 Aug 2007) is Breno, Miranda, Alex Silva as centre-backs with five midfielders and two forwards, and Jornal de Brasília (2009-06-29) calls the team 'acostumada ao 3-5-2 de Muricy', adding that he tried to drop the three centre-backs but in decisive matches always went back to the trio. Trivela (Feb 2008) says he had not decided between three and four. The Gazeta Esportiva piece titled 'Muricy aprova esquema com três zagueiros' (returned 403) is seen only in search summaries, which called 2007 a 3-4-3: not verified. MARKING: individual marking is shown in May 2006 (Jornal de Brasília) with a considered switch to zonal against aerial balls; whether it happened and what the system was in 2007-08 is not documented. PRESSING/POSSESSION: no source describes a pressing structure or possession play in these years; sources describe an obedient, compact side with strong midfield marking and counter-attacks. Ceni's 'líbero com a bola' / free kicks / penalties comes from a February 2009 Muricy quote (outside the window, verified false). Muricy's phrase 'a defesa começa na frente' is from Santos 2011 (outside), kept only in statedView as attributed. Defensive numbers (32 goals against in 2006, 19 in 2007, 36 in 2008) come from a 2024 Gazeta SP retrospective and the DOL piece, both tier C.
openQuestions: Shape 2006-08: 2006 title XI has four defenders (Gazeta SP retrospective), 2007 match XI has three centre-backs (Lancepédia), Jornal de Brasília 2009 says 3-5-2 was his habit but he used a four-man defence sometimes. A tier A/B match-level source per season would settle it; no source supports a 'flat 4-4-2'.
Gazeta Esportiva 'Especialista, Muricy aprova esquema com três zagueiros' (403) was cited in search as saying 2007 was 3-4-3 with 19 goals conceded; unread.
Marking: did Muricy adopt zonal marking against aerial balls after May 2006? Not confirmed. Midfield marking por setor is documented only at Santos 2011 (outside).
Ceni's role as líbero with the ball and set-piece taker is documented only by a Feb 2009 Muricy quote; no in-window source about Ceni's build-up role or goal counts per season was read.

Hernanes, Josué, Richarlyson and Leandro are covered by Trivela 2007/2008, but no source on Lugano in 2006-08 beyond the May 2006 article; no source found on Alex Silva vs Miranda partnership beyond the 2007 line-up.

Video analysis and obedience are documented (NSC 2006, JB 2008) but nothing quantifies squad age or rotation; only the 2008 'elenco de 22' and the nine players who stayed for all three titles (Trivela 2014).

statedView.quote: Não gosto de pôr muita pilha porque, às vezes, isso faz mal ao jogador. Quando ele entra muito aceso, esquece a tática e a técnica.

Eu analiso o momento e a maneira de jogar do adversário, além de ver individualmente cada jogador.
A defesa não começa lá atrás. Começa na frente.

confidence.reason: Tactical shape for 2006-08 is contradictory across sources (4-man defence in the 2006 title XI, 3 centre-backs in 2007), almost all tier C or retrospective; no tier A source; pressing, possession, marking system and Ceni's role in the window are undocumented. Trivela 2007/2008 (tier B) and 2006-08 press give solid facts on obedience, video analysis, squad building and defensive numbers.
